title: Rudzi Rwakaramba Kurongeka Kwechisikigo
intro: Munzvimbo ine nyaya inoramba ichidzokororwa kwemakore, nharaunda yaigara mukupandukira pachena mitemo yekuchena. Mabasa avo akanga asina kumboitika zvekuti anoyeukwa senyevero kuvanhu vese. Mweya iyi yaiva vanaani, uye chii chakavawira?
clues: Taigara munyika iri pedyo nenzira yaiwanzo pfuura nevafambi, asi takaita kuti rwendo rwavo ruve nenjodzi.
Takaita mabasa ekusazvibata asina kumbobvira aitwa nemunhu pasi rose.
Mutumwa kubva pakati pedu akatidana kuti tisiye nzira dzedu, asi takamuramba tikakumbira chirango kana akataura chokwadi.
Vaenzi vakanaka pavakauya muguta redu, takaedza kuvarwisa, tisingazive kuti vaiva nhume dzekuparadza.
Takanyeverwa nezvechirango chakaipisisa kana tikasarega, asi takaseka yambiro yacho ndokuramba tiri muchivi chedu.
Mvura yematombo yakabva kudenga yakatiwira, dzimba dzedu dzikaparadzwa, pasina kana chiratidzo chimwe chete chakasara kunze kwechiratidzo kune vanofungisisa.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Akaita unzenza husina kumboitika uye migwagwa yakavharika
Akabirirwa mukutengeserana uye akashaisa vanhu mukana wekuzviwanira mari
Vakavaka shongwe refu kuti vakwikwidze matenga
trial.answer: Akaita unzenza husina kumboitika uye migwagwa yakavharika

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
